notes.title: Transition to a USD 1 Paid Model & Sequel Production Plan Launch
notes.content:
The game [b]FrenzyRetribution[/b] will transition to a paid model of $1 to help fund development of its sequel. If sales perform well, we’ll upgrade the original title’s art assets and port it to Unreal Engine 5. No matter how the $1 launch performs, planning for the sequel is already underway—so there’s absolutely no obligation. If your budget allows, please feel free to show your support!

Below is a preview of our protagonist’s redesign. Would you prefer a more realistic, hard-edged style or an anime-inspired look? Are you drawn to the gritty, punch-in-the-face aesthetic of Ghostrunner, or the shader-rich anime vibe of CODE VEIN? Let us know which direction excites you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36065352/16e3ed52569ee34b5930e4f5b6b897e56a234f63.jpg[/img]
(If the image does not display, please use the link below: [url=https://imgur.com/a/8dZaKya]https://imgur.com/a/8dZaKya[/url])

We also hope you’ll continue backing our other titles. As a fully independent studio—with no publisher, no convoluted equity structures, and no outside investors—we retain complete creative autonomy. Your feedback reaches us directly and without bureaucracy, and we respond with full transparency. With your ongoing support, we can build even more exceptional games—together!

HowlinRain Steam Publisher and Developer Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/HowlinRain

In the future, we’ll have our studio’s game characters crossover into one another’s titles—appearing as cameos or even as playable characters!

notes.title: 【罪業狂襲FrenzyRetribution Update】
notes.content:
Tutorial system:
Fixed partial text word problem, the additional part did not explain the Tutorial.
Move some of the in-game tutorial points to the first level
Note: All tutorial can be read in the gallery first

Camera section:
Fixed an issue where the rotation speed could not keep up when the mouse was rotated
Adding a viewing angle mode, canceling the camera's following inertia, more suitable for mouse and keyboard
The additional angle of view operation reverse can adjust up and down, left and right reverse
Fine-tuning the angle of view when locked
Can be adjusted in "Options"

Protagonist:
Slightly shorten the recovery time in getting hit animation.
Perfect counterattack increases 1 frame.
Increased weapon fever consumption in berserk mode.

Boss related:
When the first stage Boss blood is zero, the player attack will force into execution.
Correcting airborne deaths during grab animation.
Fixed the problem that would be repelled by Boss's long-range attack at a normal counter.
Correct the problem of the perfect counter stun amount.

Score related:
Correct no damage score.

Gallery correction:
Story scroll can't scroll problem.

Other:
Fixed an issue where the displacement around the monster was not correct during the execution.
